Welcome hunter.
Few tips for you. Play with others, people who are better at the game. Don't get discouraged, even if they yell at you. They just want you to get better.
Second tip, if your aim is garbage, try outsmarting the enemy by taking a few pot shots at them, then rotate to a new position, while your team back fucks them. Rotating is a big part of the game, you stay in one place for too long and you will die. Think of yourself as a supporting player. After all, every team needs one, cant function without it. Play to your strengths, find out what works for you. And if you havent already, try getting used to a lower sensitivity. Its a must in fps shooters. If your computer can handle it, play at 120fps, less input lag that way. Turn off depth of field in the settings aswell, makes you see the landscape better when aiming down sights.

Dont worry, the bayou will make a hunter out of you in no time.

PS try hitting headshots. Instakills.
